content.answer: Growth and next step: A pay level caps what the post alone can pay.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: A government psychologist in India earns about ₹25,000 a month on a small fixed-amount contract and about ₹91,000 a month at the first step of a central Level 10 post, counting basic pay plus dearness allowance (DA), a cost-of-living top-up.
